question: In which of the following years was the Women’s Indian Association established in Madras (Chennai)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1917.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• At **Adayar, Madras, in 1917**, **Annie Besant, Margaret Cousins, Jeena Raja Dasa,** and others formed the **Women's Indian Association (WIA)**.
 
• The** aim** was to free women from the** dreadful conditions** they endured in **political and socio-economic affairs **in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
 
• The Association later evolved into a powerful force in the struggle against social problems like** child marriage, illiteracy, and the Devadasi system.**
 
• **Dorothy Jinarajadasa** got more involved in** theosophist internal politics **following **Besant's passing in 1933.**
 
• **Freedom fighter Muthulakshmi Reddy** served as **editor** of the WIA's monthly English journa**l "Stri-Dharma" from 1931 to 1940.** 
 
• WIA was the first women's association in India to present a** memorandum to the Round Table Conference **on** Women's Franchise **and her **Constitutional rights** as well as the initiator of the **first All Asian Women's Conference.**
